sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I pick up a postcard in a shop by the harbour.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There's a little fishing boat on it, like Dad's old boat.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want to send Dad a little surprise from my trip.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, do you sell stamps here too?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We do, and we can mail your card from here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'd like to send it to Taiwan.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, there's a price list right by the till.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It says two pounds for postcards going overseas.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, two pounds will get it to Taiwan.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll take a stamp for the card, please.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I take out a photo of myself on the harbour bridge.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I send this photo with the card, too?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Oh, you'll need an envelope for that.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I was going to tape it to the back.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It could fall off.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: This size should fit both the photo and the card.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: How much will it cost with the envelope?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: With the envelope, it'll be three pounds altogether if you use standard mail.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, how much did you say?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Three pounds in total.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That works for me, thanks.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Here's a pen if you want to write him a note.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll tell him this boat made me think of him.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I'll put his address here on the front.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I put the card and photo inside and seal the envelope.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: There we go. Can I pay by card?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, you can tap right here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: When will it go out?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Our mail goes out this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I'll put the right stamp on for you.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I hope he gets it before I get home.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I hand over the envelope and watch the stamp go on.
